packageRules.description: requirements-docker.txt is a hash-pinned export of uv.lock, not a manifest anyone edits. Renovate bumping it directly desynchronises the two: the image installs one set of versions while the lock - and so every test - keeps another, and the next legitimate regeneration silently reverts the bump. Nothing in CI would catch that, because the tests run from the lock. pyproject.toml stays managed through pep621; transitive versions move when we refresh the lock and re-export.
